name: Rapper AI
tagline: Turn performer photos into short AI rap videos with synced audio.
description:
Rapper AI (RapperAI) is an AI rap video generator built for creators, marketers, and fans who want short-form performance clips without a full editing timeline, custom lyrics workflow, or complex prompt engineering.

What it does
Rapper AI turns performer photos into short AI rap and trend-style videos. You pick a curated template, upload the photos that template requires, choose duration and aspect ratio, review the live credit quote, then generate. The template recreates staging, movement, and camera work around the people in your photos, and audio is generated together with the video. Clips can be any whole-second length from 1 to 15 seconds. Portrait (9:16) and landscape (16:9) are both supported and cost the same for a given template and settings.

Who it is for
- Creators posting to TikTok, Instagram Reels, Shorts, and other short-video feeds
- Marketers and brands testing music-forward or performance-style social creatives
- Fans who want to appear in a cypher, freestyle, or party-performance scene from a portrait
- Anyone who needs a fast photo-to-video path rather than a multi-track editor

How generation works
1. Choose a format or template — for example a close-up freestyle, a two-person studio performance, a cypher-style scene, or a trend-inspired party clip.
2. Upload the required performer photos. Some templates use one portrait; others (such as Hotel Lobby) support one lead identity for both roles or a separate partner photo for two people.
3. Set duration (1–15 seconds, whole seconds) and aspect ratio (9:16 or 16:9).
4. Review the exact credit cost shown before you generate, then generate the video. Sign-in and sufficient credits are required.

Featured templates and scenes
- Hotel Lobby — two-person studio performance from one or two portraits
- Burning Bridges — one photo places you in a chandelier party scene with crowd energy
- Bulin 47 Dembow Freestyle — street freestyle-style performance
- Desk Concert — one portrait as the lead vocalist in a desk-concert performance with generated audio
Additional curated rap-performance and short-video formats are available from the homepage creator and individual template pages.

Credits and pricing model
New accounts do not receive free signup credits. Credit packages are listed on the Pricing page. The exact quote depends on template, photo count, duration, and quality, and is rounded up in 5-credit increments. Failed generation jobs automatically return charged credits. Aspect ratio does not change cost.

Current limits (honest product notes for directory reviewers)
- You can upload performer photos as required by each template
- The current workflow does not accept audio uploads, custom prompts, or custom lyrics
- Audio is generated with the video; words, vocals, and lip sync can vary by generation

Why list Rapper AI
Rapper AI sits in the AI video / generative creative tools category with a clear, narrow job: photo-in, short rap or trend video out, with synchronized generated audio and template-guided camera and staging. That makes it a practical alternative to general-purpose AI video tools when the goal is a performance-style social clip rather than a long-form edit.

Website: https://rapperai.app

=== FAQ BLOCK (paste when the form has FAQ / extra fields / long description space) ===
What is Rapper AI?
Rapper AI is an AI rap video maker. Pick a template, upload the required photos, choose a 1–15 second duration, and generate a scene with audio.

Can Rapper AI actually generate video, or is it only tutorials?
Yes. The homepage creator and each template page run the same photo-to-video generator with synchronized generated audio.

Are all templates specifically for rap?
Live templates include two-person studio performance (Hotel Lobby), street freestyle (Bulin 47), chandelier party (Burning Bridges), and desk-concert style clips. Templates guide scene, movement, and camera around your portraits.

What is Hotel Lobby?
Hotel Lobby is a two-person performance template. One lead photo can supply both identities; an optional partner photo uses two different people.

Can I upload audio or custom lyrics?
Not in the current workflow. Photos are supported as required by the template; audio is generated with the video.

How long are videos and what do they cost?
Any whole-second duration from 1 to 15 seconds. Credits are quoted live before generate and depend on template, photos, duration, and quality.
